thesis: The README describes a compact, framework-free research agent loop with citation validation and spend limits, which makes it useful as a readable reference implementation. What the pages do not show is any sign of ongoing work — one commit in the repository and none in the last 30 days — so it should be treated as a documented prototype of unknown maintenance, not a proven tool.
